The brand offers a wide range of clothing for women, men, and children, focusing on accessible and comfortable everyday style. DeFacto has grown into a global fashion brand with more than 500 stores in over 100 countries, providing casual, trendy, and diverse apparel options for all ages.

tenants.name: Eagle Express
tenants.description: Eagle Express is a premium travel luggage and accessories brand offering a wide range of durable and stylish suitcases, travel bags, and travel gear designed to make packing and journeys easier with quality materials and functional designs.

tenants.name: Guven
tenants.description: Guven is a specialty shop offering a wide selection of premium dried fruits, nuts, sweets, and traditional treats like halqoum (Turkish delight), catering to customers who enjoy high-quality snacks and confectionery.

tenants.name: Whites Pharmacy
tenants.description: Whites is a leading Saudi Arabian beauty, lifestyle, health, and pharmacy retail chain offering a wide range of products including cosmetics, skincare, hair care, personal care, vitamins, supplements, and medicines. It operates more than 100 stores across Saudi Arabia, providing customers with a diverse selection of both everyday and premium beauty and wellness products, along with expert advice and a unique shopping experience.

tenants.name: Tolat Etr
tenants.description: Tolat Etr is a luxury perfume brand specializing in oud, musk, aromatic oils, and oriental fragrances, combining high-quality ingredients with creative craftsmanship to offer distinctive scents for customers seeking premium olfactory experiences

tenants.name: Ajwa Nakhlah
tenants.description: Ajwa Nakhlah provides high-quality dates, including specialty Ajwa varieties known for their rich flavor and natural nutrition. The brand emphasizes freshness, authenticity, and premium selection.

tenants.name: Drop Kick
tenants.description: Dropkick is a fashion and lifestyle brand offering a wide range of stylish footwear, apparel, and accessories from top global brands, designed to deliver comfort, quality, and trend-forward looks for fashion and sports enthusiasts.

tenants.name: Zbrand
tenants.description: ZBRAND is a contemporary fashion brand established in 2021 with a focus on simple, high-quality clothing designs. The brand continually works to improve its design expertise and clothing quality, prioritizing customer satisfaction and delivering a unique fashion experience.

tenants.name: Gather Eatery
tenants.description: Gather Eatery is a contemporary dining and café-style restaurant offering a diverse menu of quality meals, crafted with fresh ingredients and designed to bring people together over great food and memorable experiences

tenants.name: Cizaro
tenants.description: Cizaro is a contemporary fashion brand specializing in high-quality denim and apparel, blending timeless fits with modern style to create wardrobe staples that empower individual expression and comfort.

tenants.name: true Gamers
tenants.brand: K R A T Gaming CO
tenants.description: True Gamers is a global esports gaming café network that offers immersive high-tech gaming environments with top-tier PCs, consoles, and competitive gaming experiences. The brand creates vibrant spaces for gamers to play, compete, and enjoy community-driven tournaments and events.

tenants.name: On Time
tenants.description: On Time is a fashion retail brand specializing in stylish designer watches, jewelry, and accessories from leading international labels, offering a curated selection of timepieces and fashion pieces for men, women, and kids

tenants.name: Emirates Pride
tenants.brand: Ahmed Ibrahim Ahmed Al-bolushi Trading EST
tenants.description: Emirates Pride is a luxury perfume brand dedicated to creating distinctive and high-quality Arabian fragrances, including oriental perfumes, oud blends, incense (Dakhoons), and aromatic scent collections crafted with premium ingredients and expert craftsmanship to evoke elegance and cultural heritage

tenants.name: DKNY
tenants.description: DKNY (Donna Karan New York) is a global fashion brand founded in 1989 and inspired by the energy and attitude of New York City. The brand offers contemporary apparel, accessories, footwear, and licensed products designed to fit modern lifestyles with versatile and stylish pieces rooted in urban spirit and practical design.

tenants.name: Makarim
tenants.description: Makarem is a leading hospitality brand dedicated to authentic service and exceptional guest experiences, rooted in rich tradition and guided by warm, thoughtful hospitality values. Their offerings focus on comfort, service excellence, and memorable stays for guests.

tenants.name: Athletic Co.
tenants.description: Athlete’s Co. is a multi-brand sports lifestyle retailer offering athletic footwear, casual and fashion sports-inspired footwear and apparel from global brands such as New Balance, Skechers, Adidas, Crocs, Ralph Lauren Polo, Lacoste and more. It operates under the Apparel Group umbrella with stores located across the Middle East, including Saudi Arabia, providing a wide selection of stylish, athleisure and performance products.

tenants.name: Zey
tenants.description: Zey is a lifestyle and medical clothing brand offering high-quality medical uniforms, scrubs, lab coats, and accessories designed for comfort, durability, and style, with a focus on meeting the needs of healthcare professionals through practical and stylish products

tenants.name: Bateel
tenants.description: Bateel is a luxury gourmet brand known for its premium organic dates, handcrafted chocolates, gourmet gifts and fine foods. The brand pioneered the transformation of dates into a refined gourmet product and operates boutiques and café experiences around the world.

tenants.name: Shader
tenants.description: SHADER is a premium fashion brand specializing in elegant, high-quality abayas and modest wear, known for its refined designs and craftsmanship that reflect timeless style and attention to detail.

tenants.name: Seera
tenants.description: Seera is a fashion brand specializing in elegant women’s shoes and accessories, offering designs that blend beauty with high quality to meet the style needs of modern women.

tenants.name: Einbu
tenants.description: Einbu (عنبو) is a food brand in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia known for offering Middle‑Eastern food items (like grape leaves, musakhan, eggplant rolls, and similar prepared foods). The brand is active on Instagram where it promotes its fresh food products and emphasizes quality and flavor in its offerings — “the taste has a word and we do not compromise on quality.”

tenants.name: Thai Soi
tenants.description: Thai Soi is a registered Thai food brand offering authentic Thai-inspired cuisine with a menu featuring classic and contemporary dishes crafted to deliver bold flavours and a vibrant dining experience.

tenants.name: Wing Stop
tenants.description: Wingstop is an American international fast-casual restaurant brand specializing in hand-cooked chicken wings and bold, distinctive flavors, offering classic and boneless wings, tenders, sandwiches and seasoned sides. Its mission is “to Serve the World Flavor,” and the brand has expanded globally with thousands of restaurants in dozens of countries since it was founded in 1994 in Garland, Texas.

tenants.name: Gong Cha
tenants.description: Gong Cha is a global bubble tea and specialty beverage brand known for its premium freshly brewed teas, customizable drinks with toppings like pearls and signature milk foam, crafted with quality ingredients and innovative flavor combinations.

tenants.name: Yolé
tenants.description: Yolé is a Spanish brand pioneering healthy frozen desserts, specializing in zero sugar added frozen yogurt and zero dairy, zero sugar added ice cream made from natural ingredients like oat milk for a premium, indulgent taste without compromising health

tenants.name: Corn World
tenants.brand: Shareef Bin Abdullah Bin Omar Bakerman EST
tenants.description: Corn World is a vibrant, fun brand specializing in a variety of delicious corn-based snacks and dishes. From buttery, savory corn on the cob to creative, flavorful twists, Corn World brings the joy of fresh, high-quality corn to every bite, offering a tasty experience for all ages.

tenants.name: Popeyes Restaurant
tenants.brand: Gulf Brand For Fast Food CO
tenants.description: Popeyes Saudi Arabia serves mouth-watering, crunchy, and juicy fried chicken, bursting with authentic Louisiana flavor.

tenants.name: Cold Stone
tenants.description: Cold Stone Creamery is an American international ice cream parlor chain known for premium ice cream made fresh in stores and customized with mix-ins on a frozen granite stone. The brand also offers ice cream cakes, smoothies, shakes, and other frozen treats, creating an indulgent dessert experience enjoyed worldwide.

tenants.name: Doka
tenants.description: Doka Bakery & Restaurant offers a delightful blend of freshly baked goods, artisanal pastries, and delicious restaurant-style meals , crafted with high-quality ingredients for an unforgettable dining experience.

tenants.name: Whata Slider
tenants.brand: ASQ International Food And Beverages CO
tenants.description: What began as a Slider restaurant in dammam, Saudi Arabia , continues to soar to great heights. We are more than 10 restaurants open across Kingdom of Saudi Arabia,Whataslider quickly became a fan favorite when we first opened. Our proprietary recipes, outstanding food and superior customer service created a demand that could only be satisfied by more locations. And we began offering franchises. we are one of the growing concepts in the country, attracting top entrepreneurs and operators with the drive and passion to own their own business.Since setting up shop, we’ve been putting flavor first. And we’re not about to stop. We’re all about taking our sliders to another level, saucing and tossing the freshest flavors you crave along the way.OUR MISSION: TO SERVE THE FLAVORWe’re not in the burger business. We’re in the flavor business. It’s been our mission to serve flavor since we first opened. we’re just getting started.It’s flavor that defines us and has made whtaslider one of the great brands in the fast food restaurant industry. Hand-cut seasoned fries is our famous sides. For people who demand flavor in everything they do, there’s only whataslider – because it’s more than a meal, it’s a flavor experience

tenants.name: Barn's Cafe
tenants.description: Barn’s is a Saudi coffee café brand known for its specialty coffee, unique blends, and café experience. It has been part of the Saudi coffee scene since 1992, recognized as one of the early local coffee shops and the first to introduce a drive-through service in the Kingdom. The brand focuses on quality roasting and serving memorable coffee experiences, with widespread presence across major Saudi cities.

tenants.name: Starbucks
tenants.description: Starbucks offers a variety of premium coffees, teas, and fresh snacks, perfect for a quick break or casual meet-up. Enjoy rich flavors and cozy vibes!

tenants.name: Douh L'Douh Bakery Cafe
tenants.description: vibrant establishment inviting you to experience a bakery revolution with perfect combinations of dough. In addition to our delightful baked goods, we offer a wide variety of surprising drinks to complement your plate.

tenants.name: Kudu Restaurant
tenants.description: Kudo Restaurant offers meals that are prepared directly in front of the customer based on his request.

tenants.name: Baskin Robbins
tenants.description: We are the first company to introduce an international brand of ice cream in the region. Today, we have the largest store network in the Quick Service Restaurants (QSR) industry in the Gulf Region. We plan to expand even further in the coming years by adding more leading brands to our portfolio across many markets. Frozen dessert treats, and Ice cream

tenants.name: Tim Hortons
tenants.description: Tim Hortons is a popular Canadian chain known for its signature premium-blend coffee, alongside a selection of light fare, freshly baked pastries, and delicious breakfast sandwiches. With a cozy atmosphere and fast, friendly service, it’s the perfect spot to enjoy quality coffee and a quick bite throughout the day.

tenants.name: Herfy
tenants.description: Herfy is a Saudi Arabian multinational fast food restaurant chain in Saudi Arabia and one of the largest in the Middle East, surpassing international chains in terms of presence. It has a total of more than 380 restaurants and 5,000 employees throughout Saudi Arabia. The company has many subsidiaries including Herfy Bakery.

tenants.name: CINNABON
tenants.description: Founded in Seattle in 1985 and now based in Atlanta, Cinnabon is the market leader among cinnamon roll bakeries. The company serves fresh, aromatic, oven-hot cinnamon rolls, as well as a variety of other baked goods and speciality beverages. As of March 26, 2023 Cinnabon had more than 1,850 locations worldwide, primarily in high traffic venues such as shopping malls, airports, train stations, travel plazas, entertainment centres.

tenants.name: Lily Flower&Coffe
tenants.description: Lily is a flower, gift and lifestyle brand offering a wide variety of fresh floral arrangements, bouquets, and curated gift bundles that combine flowers with treats like coffee, cakes, and chocolates to help express feelings and celebrate special moments.

tenants.name: Paul Cafe
tenants.description: Come for our fresh , delicious fare , and stay for a dining experience you wont forget

tenants.name: Zafran
tenants.description: Zafran Indian Kitchen is an award-winning contemporary Indian restaurant concept specializing in authentic North-West Frontier cuisine with rich, robust flavors. Founded in the UAE and expanded to Saudi Arabia, Zafran offers a distinctive dining experience with sought-after Indian classics like biryanis, curries, and signature dishes in a refined, warm setting.

tenants.name: Steak House
tenants.brand: Alfa Co. for Operation Services Ltd
tenants.description: Steak House KSA is the most award-winning restaurant in Saudi Arabia, renowned for its exceptional quality, premium cuts, and impeccable service. With a legacy of excellence, Steak House KSA offers a refined dining experience where each steak is expertly prepared and perfectly cooked to meet the highest standards.

tenants.name: Al Baik
tenants.description: Al Baik is a leading fast-food restaurant chain known for its signature broasted chicken, seafood, sandwiches, and variety of sauces, built on decades of quality, speedy service, and customer-focused dining experiences.

tenants.name: Piatto
tenants.brand: Alfa Co. for Operation Services Ltd
tenants.description: Piatto is an authentic Italian restaurant and steakhouse where passion for flavor meets culinary craftsmanship. From hand-crafted pastas to perfectly grilled steaks, each dish is designed to deliver a taste of Italy with a bold, hearty twist.

tenants.name: Nando's
tenants.description: Nando’s is a South African-founded global restaurant brand known for its flame-grilled PERi-PERi chicken — marinated in spicy, Portuguese-style sauces and grilled over fire to deliver flavorful, char-grilled meals with bold taste and personality.

tenants.name: SUSHI LIBRARY
tenants.description: Sushi Library is a family-friendly casual Japanese restaurant brand offering a wide range of fresh sushi and Japanese-inspired dishes for all tastes and budgets. The menu is designed for both sushi beginners and enthusiasts, providing a vibrant dining experience with creative flavors and an inviting atmosphere that celebrates sharing food and culinary adventure

tenants.name: Jamie's ITALIAN
tenants.description: Jamie’s Italian is a globally recognized casual-dining restaurant brand founded by chef Jamie Oliver, celebrating authentic Italian cuisine with freshly sourced ingredients, handmade pasta, vibrant antipasti, and warm hospitality that brings people together.

tenants.name: COSTA COFFEE
tenants.description: Costa Coffee is a British multinational coffeehouse chain known for its expertly crafted coffee, signature blends, and diverse menu of hot and cold beverages, snacks, and light meals, built on decades of roasting expertise and global café culture.
